name: Notes, Sources and Subsequent Events
required_scope: Strengthen debt maturity, revolver, covenant, lease, receivable, bad-debt, supplier-finance, acquisition, amendment, restatement, and subsequent-event evidence.
Do not silently resolve material source conflicts or stale post-period information.
Implement analytical controls in shared components without ticker-specific patches.

requirement_acceptance.evidence: Debt carrying values, current/non-current classification, contractual maturity evidence, and amendment or waiver signals are separately evaluated.
Facility disclosure, commitment or capacity, usage or availability, maturity, and restrictions are evaluated in a first-class module; availability is not treated as covenant headroom.
Disclosed compliance, numerical headroom, availability, and missing calculations remain distinct.
Lease carrying values remain separate from undiscounted contractual payment schedules.
Receivable balances, allowance basis, provision, write-offs, and recoveries retain period and source lineage; missing values are not converted to zero.
NOT_APPLICABLE requires an explicit disclosure basis; silence remains MISSING.
Acquisition amounts are bound to the selected filing accession and period; transaction terms and accounting disclosures are required; unselected facts cannot become unvalidated duplicate amounts.
Administrative amendments remain qualified, while financial restatements and non-reliance events can trigger a Hard Stop.
Later filings and material events retain event dates and cannot be silently mixed into historical balances.
A material same-grain source conflict creates a Hard Stop; the acquisition conflict path has a dedicated regression test.

scope_boundary: Keyword and filing-index detection identifies evidence candidates but does not replace analyst review of legal agreements or footnotes.
MISSING and WARNING are intentional constrained outcomes and do not imply that undisclosed evidence exists.
Financial institutions and specialized capital structures remain outside the current shared non-financial issuer core.
